objective: Automatically deliver authorized primary content to the persistent reader, independently of writer execution; reader interprets impact, writer preserves and completes accepted work, responder communicates source-bound answers.

architecture.backbone: Hollywood retains canonical events, ACLs, original authorship and distinct input/work/response states.
architecture.input: LAX fetches full authorized pending input automatically, including role and current own unfinished work. No model tool choice gates primary visibility.
architecture.native: Existing thread/injectItems appends bounded named tool output fragments. Active turns consume queued input at native model-step boundaries. No assertion that in-flight provider calls can change.
architecture.admission: Initial input is appended before reader inference. Later arrivals extend only the current reader's captured input after confirmed append. Work and response obligations stay distinct from delivery.
architecture.histories: Reader, writer and responder remain independent native histories; raw room messages never steer writer or enter responder.
architecture.recovery: Journal native append intent and receipt. On uncertain append, observe exact original history before any retry; never replay work or infer interpretation from delivery.
architecture.scope: New disposable native cohort on existing private QA authority; existing production, Global pilot, phone profiles and deliberate stops preserved.

acceptance: Transcript contains exact original input body and provenance without model-initiated retrieval of that input.
Relevant event arrives during actual writer work and is interpreted by reader while original writer turn remains active.
An event arriving during reader inference enters the same reader history without turn/interrupt or human steering.
Relevant interpretation amends existing objective-bearing work; unrelated observation creates no assignment or required acknowledgement.
Status/question receives an attributable responder answer while original work remains open.
Original deliverable completes and passes independent frozen output checks including the unforeseen change.
Existing original input/delivery/work identities retained, no duplicate task submission or owner semantic intervention.
Repeat with reader restart and native compaction; inspect causal inputs and resulting artifact, not just terminal states.
failure: Any omitted authorized pending event, wrong authorship/audience, objective replacement, silent dropped obligation, acknowledgement cycle, duplicate task or manual semantic repair.
Passing only state transitions or substituted model decisions.
Observed message retrieval counted as proof of understanding.
Any failure remains in the run record; a repaired run is a separate qualified revision.
stages: Run one real model workflow and independently inspect artifact and event trace.
Repeat the frozen scenario with altered timing, restart and compaction.
Then extend to multiple native agents and rooms before rollout.
evidenceLimits: Finite trials support bounded behavior, never universal semantic reliability, deadlock freedom, exactly-once external effects or full Codex replacement.
